caption:
Lulu ramped up her pull-ups this month, and now the inside of her elbow aches after every session.

Tendons usually adapt more slowly than muscles. A big jump in reps can leave the elbow tendons feeling cranky. Rather than stopping altogether, it often helps to ease back to a comfortable amount and build up gradually.

Hybi's reset: fewer reps for now, try a neutral grip, and add slow wrist curls with a light weight, 3 sets of 10.

Swelling, finger tingling, or pain lasting more than two weeks is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 💪
